evidence.reason: The finding's concern — that `./.`, `.//.` and similar dot-segment prefixes pass exemption validation and resolve to the workspace root, letting `isExemptPath` (which accepts `absolute === base` plus descendants) exempt every dirty path — is addressed by the recorded fixing commit 4ff8b813f36586b502d69cb6b9218665633915ca ("fix(review): reject root-resolving exempt prefixes and report v2 schema errors"), which specifically rejects root-resolving exempt prefixes. The current contract carries no requirement contradicting this hardening; item 22 (protect the deployed system) and the approval-gated remediation posture (item 9) are consistent with tightening the exempt-prefix validation.
